content.thinking:
Two issues in my test:
1. 'dup event key': `json.dumps([{'op':'inspect','op':'inspect'}])` — Python collapses the duplicate key in the dict literal before dumping! So the output has no duplicate. I need raw text: `J` builds with json.dumps(events). Let me use a raw string with a duplicate key.

2. The `%` formatting with two `%s`-ish placeholders — `'{"jobs":[...{"op":"commit","epoch":%s}]}]}'%('9'*4301,)` has `%LIM` missing. Let me fix the format args.

Let me fix the test file.

arguments.command:
cd /workspace/tmp/tests && python3 - <<'EOF'
p='t_validation.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("""raw(J([{'op':'inspect','op':'inspect'}]), INVALID, 'dup event key')""",
"""raw('{"jobs":[{"services":[{"name":"A","label":1}],"limits":%s,"events":[{"op":"inspect","op":"inspect"}]}]}'%LIM, INVALID, 'dup event key')""")
s=s.replace("""raw('{"jobs":[{"services":[{"name":"A","label":1}],"limits":%s,"events":[{"op":"commit","epoch":%s}]}]}'%('9'*4301,), INVALID, 'int 4301 digits')
raw('{"jobs":[{"services":[{"name":"A","label":1}],"limits":%s,"events":[{"op":"commit","epoch":%s}]}]}'%('9'*4300,), JOBINV, 'int 4300 digits -> job invalid (out of range)')
raw('{"jobs":[{"services":[{"name":"A","label":1}],"limits":%s,"events":[{"op":"inspect"}],"x":%s}]}'%('9'*4301,), INVALID, 'long int elsewhere')""",
"""raw('{"jobs":[{"services":[{"name":"A","label":1}],"limits":'+LIM+',"events":[{"op":"commit","epoch":'+'9'*4301+'}]}]}', INVALID, 'int 4301 digits')
raw('{"jobs":[{"services":[{"name":"A","label":1}],"limits":'+LIM+',"events":[{"op":"commit","epoch":'+'9'*4300+'}]}]}', JOBINV, 'int 4300 digits -> job invalid')
raw('{"jobs":[{"services":[{"name":"A","label":1}],"limits":'+LIM+',"events":[{"op":"inspect"}],"x":'+'9'*4301+'}]}', INVALID, 'long int elsewhere')
raw('{"jobs":[{"services":[{"name":"A","label":1}],"limits":'+LIM+',"events":[{"op":"commit","epoch":-'+'9'*4301+'}]}]}', INVALID, 'negative long int')""")
open(p,'w').write(s)
EOF
cd /workspace/tmp/tests && python3 t_validation.py 2>&1 | grep -v '^ok'
